candidates.content_text:
Company Description
Work with Us. Change the World.
At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.
There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.
We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.
Job Description
Play a key role in delivering a diverse range of exciting infrastructure projects across roads, commercial and industrial developments, sports, resources, water infrastructure, defence and renewable energy.
You’ll be responsible for developing high-quality civil design models, drawings and technical documentation across projects ranging from local roads and parklands to mine sites, dams, substations, BESS facilities, solar farms and wind farms.
What you'll be doing
- Develop detailed civil design models using 12d Model, including earthworks, roadworks, surface grading, DDA pedestrian access, pavements, drainage networks, culverts and open channels.
- Deliver designs across water and sewer infrastructure, including pipelines, water and sewer reticulation and pump stations, as well as stormwater and bio-retention systems.
- Produce high-quality drawings and documentation using AutoCAD, aligned with client requirements, industry standards and relevant government and regulatory requirements.
- Undertake geometry assessments and swept-path analysis to ensure designs are practical, safe and fit for purpose.
- Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary project teams, coordinating civil interfaces with architectural, structural, landscape, hydraulic, geotechnical, mechanical, electrical, communications, process and environmental disciplines.
- Contribute to design and model reviews, clash detection and safety-in-design activities, ensuring quality is embedded throughout the design process.
- Prepare and review technical inputs for Bills of Quantities, balancing safety, constructability, operational requirements and cost efficiency.
- Work directly with regional project teams to understand requirements, resolve technical queries and deliver work packages to agreed scope, programme and budget.
- Support quality assurance by checking your own work and, where appropriate, reviewing the work of less experienced team members in line with AECOM's quality procedures.
- Contribute to the ongoing improvement of our civil design capability through standard details, design libraries, digital workflows, lessons learned and continuous improvement initiatives.
Qualifications
What you'll bring
We’re looking for someone with a background in civil design and drafting who is keen to contribute to diverse, multidisciplinary projects. You don’t need to tick every box, if you have the right experience and attitude, we’d love to hear from you.
- Civil Engineering qualification (Associate Degree, Diploma, Advanced Diploma or Degree).
- 2+ years’ civil design and drafting experience, ideally across urban, rural, commercial, residential, industrial or mining projects.
- Strong experience in road geometry, pavements, earthworks, grading and drainage design.
- Advanced AutoCAD skills, with experience in 12d Model and vehicle tracking.
- Experience developing civil drawings, models and quantity take-offs.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills, including working with multidisciplinary and international teams.
- Experience with water and sewer infrastructure, including reticulation, pump stations, rising mains, pipelines and reservoirs, is highly regarded.
- Familiarity with relevant Australian standards and guidelines, including Austroads, QUDM, WSAA and IPWEA, is desirable.
- Experience taking designs from concept through to construction documentation, as well as working within multidisciplinary model review environments.
- Experience mentoring junior or cadet drafters and contributing to design capability development is advantageous.
You must be an Australian citizen and be eligible to obtain an Australian Government Baseline security clearance.

candidates.content_text:
Role Overview
The Residue Storage and Industrial Earthworks Civil Engineering Draftsperson prepares detailed civil engineering drawings, plans, sections, technical schedules, and as-constructed documentation in support of engineers and senior design personnel. The position specialises in residue storage and associated industrial civil infrastructure, including containment embankments and wall lifts, retaining structures and buttresses, earthworks, underdrainage, decant pipework, and underground services. Using approved engineering design information, survey data, and site records, the role translates technical requirements into coordinated construction, tender, excavation-planning, and quality-assurance drawing packages.
Key Responsibilities
1. Planning, Engineering Interpretation, and Preparation
- Review engineering design drawings, specifications, site surveys, existing service records, and work instructions to establish drafting requirements and deliverables.
- Interpret topographic and as-constructed survey data, reduced levels, coordinates, chainages, contours, and existing site conditions for incorporation into civil engineering drawings.
- Establish drawing files, relevant references, layouts, legends, scales, and documentation standards in line with project and company requirements.
2. Specialised Civil Engineering Drafting and Documentation
- Prepare general arrangement plans, detailed layouts, profiles, cross-sections, and construction details for residue storage embankments, retaining-wall lifts, buttresses, ramps, berms, and related civil earthworks.
- Develop detailed underdrainage, drainage, and decant drawings, including HDPE pipe and draincoil alignments, diameters, connection and tie-in details, invert levels, grades, and minimum cover requirements based on approved designs.
- Prepare and revise earthworks drawings showing existing and proposed surfaces, contours, crest levels, batter slopes, grading, cut-and-fill extents, and associated quantity tables.
- Produce excavation and dig-permit services plans showing known underground and above-ground services, proposed work boundaries, service interfaces, and potential conflicts for engineering and site review.
- Prepare setting-out information and supporting schedules, including coordinates, reduced levels, pipe quantities, drawing notes, and section references for construction coordination.
3. Survey Integration, Quality Assurance, and As-Constructed Records
- Use survey and as-constructed information to prepare QA plots, long-sections, and comparative drawings for underdrainage, decant installations, retaining walls, and related civil works.
- Document design levels, surveyed as-constructed levels, grades, and variances in tabulations and drawings for engineer review; identify discrepancies without independently certifying design or construction compliance.
- Incorporate redlines, approved design updates, and review comments, and maintain drawing accuracy, traceability, and issue status.
4. Technical Coordination, Quality Control, and File Management
- Coordinate drawing interfaces among earthworks, liner boundaries, access roads, pipelines, civil services, and adjacent infrastructure; flag potential conflicts or missing information to the responsible engineer or senior drafter.
- Check drawing dimensions, coordinates, annotations, levels, scales, sheets, and cross-references against source information and applicable project specifications.
- Maintain version-controlled CAD files, revision registers, drawing issue records, and supporting technical documentation; liaise with engineers, surveyors, supervisors, and other project personnel.
Technical Systems and Capabilities
- AutoCAD: Detailed civil engineering drafting, layouts, profiles, sections, schedules, and revision management.
- Autodesk Civil 3D: Surface and contour information, grading and earthworks representations, profile/section inputs, and coordinated civil drawing preparation.
- Propeller: Review and interpretation of drone-survey surfaces, terrain information, and site data for drafting and QA support.
- Nearmap: Review of aerial imagery and site context to assist infrastructure identification and drawing coordination.
- Applied Civil Drafting Skills: Interpreting survey coordinates and reduced levels; preparing chainage, grade, invert-level, and as-constructed variance tabulations; identifying services interfaces.
Qualifications and Experience
- Relevant qualification in civil engineering, civil engineering drafting, or a closely related discipline.
- At least one (1) year of relevant post-qualification experience in civil engineering drafting consistent with the role and applicable occupational requirements.
- Practical civil engineering drafting experience using AutoCAD; capability with Civil 3D and interpretation of engineering and survey data.
- Demonstrated ability to prepare detailed civil plans and sections for earthworks, retaining structures, drainage, underground services, or comparable civil infrastructure.
- Understanding of drawing QA, document control, construction interfaces, and the need to work under appropriate engineering direction.
- Experience in residue storage, industrial infrastructure, tailings, or water-management earthworks is highly desirable for assigned projects.
Working Conditions
Predominantly office/CAD-based work, with site visits and coordination at operational industrial locations as required by project needs and applicable inductions.

- Technical Design & Documentation: Prepare and review Traffic Management Plans (TMPs) and Traffic Guidance Schemes (TGSs) using AutoCAD and GIS software in accordance with Main Roads WA requirements.

- Authority Liaison & Quality Assurance: Coordinate permit submissions and approvals with Main Roads WA, local government authorities, and utility coordinators while maintaining comprehensive project records, inspection logs, and drawing revision registers.
Qualifications
- Diploma in Civil Engineering, Civil Construction, Engineering Technology, or a relevant discipline; or
-  3 years of relevant work experience as a Civil Engineering Technician / Draftsperson
The Ideal Candidate Must Have the Following Attributes:
- Demonstrated proficiency in AutoCAD and GIS software for civil drafting and site spatial research.
- Practical understanding of fundamental civil works concepts, civil construction methodologies, and traffic management protocols.
- Working knowledge of key industry standards including AS 1742.3:2019, Austroads AGTTM, and the Main Roads WA Code of Practice.
- Knowledge of WHS legislation governing High-Risk Construction Work (HRCW) and risk management principles.
- Hold (or be willing to obtain) a White Card (General Construction Induction) and Advanced Worksite Traffic Management (AWTM) accreditation in Western Australia.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to prepare technical documentation and coordinate with clients, local councils, and contractors.
- Be reliable, punctual, honest, well-presented, and hardworking.
- Be a motivated individual who enjoys working in a dynamic, team-oriented environment.

If you're looking for a new challenge, the Army Reserve could be for you. You'll enjoy the satisfaction of giving something back to Australia, while benefitting from:

- Tax-free daily pay  
- Free healthcare and accommodation whilst on exercise or deployment

- Comprehensive training   
- A supportive team environment  
- Can volunteer to deploy overseas 
- Friendships that last a lifetime  
- No minimum period of service, allowing you to leave and come back to the Army Reserve whenever you like 
Boost Your Income 
On completion of your initial military and employment training, you could earn at least $283/day tax-free. 
The pay you receive in the Army Reserve goes straight into your pocket with no deductions for tax, and it increases as you gain seniority and experience. Additional amounts are paid for time spent on exercises and deployments. 
Eligibility:   
For this role, you must:  
- Be at least 17 at the time of enlistment and an Australian Citizen.  
- If you are not an Australian Citizen you may still be eligible to join the ADF if you meet certain criteria, please visit the ADF Careers Eligibility Page for more details  
- Be reasonably fit and healthy. Keeping fit is a big part of joining the ADF. You’ll need to pass a physical fitness test before you join, but don’t worry, we'll give you tips to help you prepare.  
- Be able to successfully obtain a security clearance.

- Have had training in a branch of engineering with the practical experience required for graduate membership of the Institution of Engineers Australia (IEAust), or another chartered institution of similar status.

Reporting to our Engineering Leader, this is a fantastic opportunity for a recent graduate or early-career engineer to gain hands-on experience delivering engineering projects in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
You'll work alongside experienced engineers, get involved in a variety of projects and see your ideas come to life on the brewery floor!

- Supporting engineering and capital projects from planning through to installation and commissioning.
- Working closely with our Brewing, Packaging, Quality and Engineering teams to deliver practical solutions.

- Getting hands-on exposure to brewery equipment, production processes and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Learning from experienced engineers and collaborating with our wider Group Engineering team.

You don't need years of experience! We're more interested in finding someone who's curious, proactive and eager to learn.
Ideally, you'll bring:
- A completed or near-completed degree in Mechanical, Chemical or Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
- A genuine interest in manufacturing, engineering projects and problem-solving.
- A practical, hands-on approach and willingness to get involved on site.
- Good communication, teamwork and organisational skills.
- A proactive attitude and commitment to safety and continuous improvement.
Previous experience through internships, university projects or manufacturing placements would be great, but isn't essential.
Application closes on Monday 23rd of November.

• Flexible work options

Apply online via Smart Jobs and provide:
• Your CV or resume (maximum five pages).
• A statement (maximum two pages) outlining how your capabilities, knowledge and experience are relevant to the role, what you will bring and your motivation for applying.

We foster an inclusive workplace culture and strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and life experiences. TMR is committed to reconciliation and creating a workplace that empowers Aboriginal peoples and Torres Strait Islander peoples to thrive.

This is an opportunity to contribute to a growing tender pipeline while working with experienced tendering teams in both Newcastle and Victoria.

You will assess project scope, construction methodology, quantities, resources, market pricing, contractual requirements and tender risks, and support the development of high-quality submissions within required timeframes.
As a Civil Estimator, you will:
• Prepare detailed first-principles estimates for civil water and structures projects, including pump stations and treatment plants
• Develop work breakdown structures, requests for quotation, procurement plans and tender pricing
• Review drawings, specifications, scopes, addenda, contracts and bills of quantities
• Obtain and evaluate subcontractor and supplier quotations, including benchmarking and gap analysis
• Identify scope gaps, estimating risks, latent conditions and contractual exposures before submission
• Support commercial reviews, tender negotiations and compliant submissions

• Relevant qualification in Civil Engineering, Construction Management or a related field
• Five or more years’ experience in a tendering or estimating role within civil water infrastructure
• Strong understanding of civil construction methodologies and engineering drawings
• Demonstrated ability to prepare accurate estimates and manage competing tender deadlines
• Strong commercial awareness, attention to detail and stakeholder communication skills
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office

 - Access to an Employee Assistance Program.

Our ‘One Team’ culture is built on collaboration, trust and shared accountability, creating an environment where people at every stage of their career can contribute and make a meaningful impact.

Click the Apply button and upload a copy of your resume. The successful applicant must have full working rights in Australia, provide contactable references, complete a criminal history check, and undergo a pre-employment medical and drug and alcohol screening.

Saunders embraces the values of an innovative and diverse workforce and recognises that inclusion sets us all up for success. We're passionate about delivering quality outcomes for our clients while creating an environment where our people can grow, develop and enjoy what they do.
About the opportunity
As our business continues to grow, we're looking for a talented Mid-Level Civil Engineer to join our Brisbane team.
This is an opportunity to take the next step in your engineering career, working alongside experienced professionals on a diverse range of exciting projects. You'll have the chance to broaden your technical experience, take ownership of your own projects, build strong client relationships and play an active role in delivering quality engineering solutions.

- Working collaboratively with experienced engineers, technical specialists and project support staff.
- Being actively involved in design teams, with opportunities to take on a leadership role.
- Managing your own projects, from initial design through to delivery.
- Building and maintaining strong client relationships.
- Engaging directly with clients and stakeholders to deliver practical, high-quality outcomes.
About you
We're looking for someone who is technically capable, motivated and ready to take on greater responsibility.
You'll ideally bring:
- A Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering.
- 5–7 years' relevant industry experience.
- Working towards or already attained RPEQ and/or CPEng accreditation
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- The ability to work collaboratively within a team while also being confident working autonomously.
- Experience working in design teams, with an interest in developing your leadership capabilities.
- A genuine desire to expand your technical knowledge across a range of engineering disciplines.
- Confidence communicating directly with clients and managing professional relationships.
